signature: SUBROUTINE DLASDT( N, LVL, ND, INODE, NDIML, NDIMR, MSUB )

params.name: N
params.reference: On entry, the number of diagonal elements of the bidiagonal matrix.

params.name: lvl
params.reference: On exit, the number of levels on the computation tree.

params.name: nd
params.reference: On exit, the number of nodes on the tree.

params.name: NDIML
params.reference: On exit, row dimensions of left children.

params.name: NDIMR
params.reference: On exit, row dimensions of right children.

params.name: msub
params.reference: On entry, the maximum row dimension each subproblem at the bottom of the tree can be of.
